title: An ideal husband
author: Oscar Wilde
description: "An Ideal Husband" by Oscar Wilde is a four-act play first produced in 1895.
longDescription: When a respected politician faces blackmail over a youthful indiscretion, his carefully constructed life threatens to collapse. His wife demands unwavering moral perfection, unaware of the secret that built their fortune.

authorInfo.bio: Oscar Wilde was an Irish writer celebrated for his wit, fairy tales and plays. The Picture of Dorian Gray is his only novel. His other works include The Importance of Being Earnest, The Happy Prince and The Ballad of Reading Gaol, spanning comedy, beauty and painful reflection.
authorInfo.edition: Complete source edition with preface and twenty chapters. Cover reproduced from the Project Gutenberg source EPUB.
